sources.title: AgentVera public README
sources.locator: At a glance, New in 0.7-0.9, Supported agents, What it does, Download
sources.finding: Closed-source desktop app running 18 agent CLIs in real terminals per project on macOS, Windows and Linux; worktree per agent; own subscriptions; agent teams with manager and roles; flows; code review, Verify and checkpoints; account switching; skill gallery; phone control; MCP, database and SSH managers; organizations, team kanban and webhooks; Free plan described as unlimited agents.

sources.title: AgentVera CHANGELOG
sources.finding: 0.9.0 adds themes, languages, project board MCP, shareable templates and night shift summary; 0.8.17 switches accounts at the limit between turns.

sources.title: Docs: Run agents side by side
sources.finding: Supported agents list; grids 1x1 to 5x4 per project; projects keep running in the background; optional git worktree per agent with a warning when two agents edit the same file; groups with shared notice boards.

sources.title: Docs: Auto-switch accounts
sources.finding: Pro and Team: account chains for Claude Code and Codex; switch at a threshold (default 3% left) read every 90 seconds; waits up to 20 minutes for a running turn; 5-minute cooldown.

sources.title: Docs: Team kanban
sources.finding: Pro and Team: shared board with To do, In progress, Test and Done; cards with labels, members, due dates, checklists, attachments and comments; assign a card to a running agent; its last reply posts as a comment and moves the card to Test or Review; cards stored on AgentVera's server.

sources.title: Docs: MCP server manager
sources.finding: Free: add stdio, HTTP or SSE MCP servers once for all supporting CLIs, scoped to agents, groups, roles or projects; catalog of 23 servers; secrets in the OS keychain.

sources.title: Docs: Night shift
sources.finding: Pro and Team: queued tasks run in a nightly window (default 23:00-07:00), new agents work in their own worktree on night branches, two tasks in parallel by default up to six, agents commit but do not push and end with done or stuck markers; morning report; auto approval for safe permissions.

sources.title: AgentVera pricing
sources.locator: plan table and Before you pay
sources.finding: Free: 1 seat, 2 agents, 100 MB storage, all core features; Pro $9.99/month with 7-day card trial, unlimited agents, flows, team kanban, webhooks, night shift, auto approval, runner on your own server, settings sync, automatic account switching; Team $14.99/month/seat, at least 2 seats, live team view and handoff; payments by iyzico; cancel anytime; code stays on your computer, kanban data on the server.

sources.title: AgentVera privacy policy
sources.finding: Desktop data stays local; error reports and daily usage data only with consent from a first-launch card; agent commits get a Via: AgentVera line by default (can be turned off); secrets in the OS keychain; commit message generation, prompt revision and code review send text to Claude through the user's account; Telegram bot traffic relayed through AgentVera's server; update checks to agentvera.dev.

sources.title: AgentVera download
sources.finding: Installers for macOS, Windows and Linux; Windows not yet signed; Android app on Google Play, iOS coming to the App Store; AgentVera Runner on a Linux or macOS server runs agents from the browser; webhooks open kanban cards from GitHub, Sentry or other systems.

sources.title: agentvera-board-mcp index.js
sources.finding: Open MCP server storing note, decision, todo, finding and file entries in .agentvera/board.json; entries signed with the writing client's name.

sources.title: agentvera-board-mcp LICENSE
sources.finding: MIT License for the board MCP server.

sources.title: AgentVera recovery-runner
sources.finding: Pro/Team runner supports Claude, Codex, Gemini, opencode and terminals on Linux/macOS. Sessions survive client disconnect. Token pairing, allowed roots and organization membership control access; removing membership closes connections. Web-triggered task summaries send up to 6000 characters to server. CLI manages status, roots, pairing and daemon; service restart is not proof of session crash recovery.

sources.title: AgentVera recovery-hooks
sources.finding: Owners/admins create Pro/Team webhooks with optional HMAC signing, rotating secret URLs, filters and one-MB body limit. Tasks queue for offline Runner, requeue once after 30 minutes without progress, then fail; admins cancel. Delivery bodies kept seven days can be replayed; summaries persist. No exactly-once side-effect guarantee.

sources.title: AgentVera recovery-replay
sources.finding: Hidden-ref working-tree snapshots retain last 60 turns per agent and permit undo/redo without changing branch/index/stash. Local Claude/Codex session replay shows prompts, tool calls, denied approvals, errors and timing; remote sessions excluded and Codex has less detail.

sources.title: AgentVera recovery-review
sources.finding: Automatic review uses chosen Claude model on turn commits or all changes; manual review accepts working tree, staged changes or one commit. Reviews tab lists severity and file/line links; optional feedback loops at most twice. This is not evidence of a required shipping gate.

sources.title: AgentVera recovery-team
sources.finding: Current page describes manager-led persistent teams with up to 24 agents, roles, report/handoff links, shared tasks and messages, on-demand work, live steps, failure and permission indicators, and interrupt/queue controls. It distinguishes those teams from one-job parallel worktrees.

sources.title: AgentVera recovery-latest
sources.finding: Website/download advertises 0.9.3 released November 23; public GitHub release remains 0.9.0. Website notes tray continuation when window closes and cross-CLI continuation offer on quota limit; v0.9.1 allows Linux account-session file fallback without keyring. Current Free quota two conflicts with pinned unlimited-agent docs; pinned core docs also say no account needed.

sources.title: Board MCP implementation boundaries
sources.locator: index.js whole file; README settings/CLI; package.json
sources.finding: Board has CLI and three stdio MCP tools, UUID entries and mutable client/environment author labels, not cryptographic signatures. Writes atomically rename a JSON file containing last 500 entries, reads return last 80 matches. No lock or compare-and-swap across separate processes; read-modify-write can lose concurrent updates. Group environment is prompt text; separate files provide separation. No delete tool or ACL; any local writer can change body/done.

sources.title: AgentVera privacy policy: error reports, usage data, mobile and website (last updated 2026-11-01)
sources.locator: sections 2 (Error reports, usage data and feedback), 5 (Mobile app and phone access), 6 (Website and cookies) and 7 (Sharing and transfers)
sources.finding: The desktop app sends no error reports or usage data unless the user consents; a first-launch card offers Accept and Decline equally, and declining or never answering sends nothing. Consent can be withdrawn in Settings → About, which stops sending immediately. Daily usage data carries a random install ID, plus the account ID when signed in; records are kept 90 days. The mobile app contains no analytics or crash-reporting software. The marketing website uses Google Analytics and an X tag after cookie consent. The policy does not describe analytics for the hosted web app.
